name: Discord
author: WolfyMaster LLC
description: Tell your Discord when you go live or finish streaming, and post any message you like.

settings.label: Discord channel link
settings.description: The link Discord gives you for the channel to post in.

settings.label: Announce when you go live
settings.description: Post in Discord every time you start streaming.

settings.label: Go-live message
settings.description: What to post. {channel} is your channel name and {link} is your stream link.
settings.defaultValue: {channel} is live on Twitch! Come hang out: {link}

settings.label: Post when your stream ends
settings.description: Post a thank-you in Discord when you stop streaming.

settings.label: End-of-stream message
settings.description: What to post. {channel} and {link} work here too.
settings.defaultValue: {channel} just wrapped up the stream. Thanks to everyone who came by!

settings.label: Stream link
settings.description: Optional. Leave blank to link to your Twitch channel.

actions.name: Post to Discord
actions.description: Post a message, with an optional card, to your Discord channel. The step fails if Discord refuses it.

schema.label: Message
schema.description: The text to post. Leave blank to post only the card.

schema.label: Ping
schema.description: Only this setting can ping. Mentions in the text never do.

schema.label: Card title
schema.description: Leave the title and description blank for no card.

schema.label: Card link
schema.description: Turns the card title into a link.

fields.description: True once Discord accepted the message.
Discord's reference for the posted message.

actions.name: Announce go-live on Discord
actions.description: Post your go-live message. Does nothing when go-live posts are turned off.

schema.label: Channel name
schema.description: Leave blank to use the channel that just went live.

fields.description: True when the post is turned off and nothing was sent.

actions.name: Announce stream end on Discord
actions.description: Post your end-of-stream message. Does nothing when those posts are turned off.

schema.label: Channel name
schema.description: Leave blank to use the channel that just went offline.

fields.description: True when the post is turned off and nothing was sent.

workflows.name: Post on Discord when your stream ends
